The upper row displays exactly these four arrows and explicitly omits all higher-state incident transitions; it does not claim 2 is absorbing.

Verification 1.3 and local supplier def-xd-finite-state-projection-and-cemetery-lift define F={0,1}, preserve internal rate-1 arrows in each direction, and aggregate exit rate q(1,2)=1 into 1→dagger. The lower row has exactly three arrows and no outgoing arrow from dagger. In state order (0,1,dagger), off-diagonal columns are (0,1,0), (1,0,1), (0,0,0); negative outgoing-rate diagonals (-1,-2,0) reproduce the displayed column generator.

Verification 4.1 establishes the positive-probability original path 0→1→2→1. The supplier Definition sets Y_t=dagger for all t≥tau_F, so the lower path terminates at dagger on its third visited state and cannot return. Verification 3.1/F6 establishes c_F(t)=P(tau_F≤t). The figure changes none of the original proof; all original source bytes remain an exact prefix.
